segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Good morning, oh sorry, it's gone 12, I'll start again, good afternoon, Kingswell Sports Club, how can I help you?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Oh, good afternoon. I was wondering if you could give me some information about membership and facilities.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Of course. What would ~ou like to know?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Do you have tennis courts, for ?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: No, I'm afraid we don't. We're primarily a golf club.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: What about football? I heard you had a team.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: No, I'm sorry. Perhaps you're thinking about Fresham Sports Centre.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Oh, right. I know it. I've played badminton there.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Have you? They've got a lot of facilities we don't have and vice versa. We do have a keep-fit studio, which is very popular with members, and then as well as that there's swimming, of course.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: That's good. I like to swim every day.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: We have a range of classes too.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Do you have judo classes? I'm keen to learn.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Well, at the moment we offer kick-boxing. We're planning to add judo and stretch classes soon. We're currently running a range of yQ!@ classes, too.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: What about relaxing after exercise? I assume you have a restaurant or something.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: At the moment, we've got a salad bar which is very popular. We'll also have a fully-licensed restaurant by the end of the year.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Sounds good!

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: What kind of membership are you interested in?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Urn I'm not really sure. What are the options?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Well, there are three different membership schemes.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: I see. What's the difference?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Well, the first one's called Gold, and you can use all the facilities at any time of the day or week. You can also join in as many classes as you like for free.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: That sounds good. Is it very expensive?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Well, you pay a £250 joining fee and then it's £450 - oh no, I'm sorry, it's just gone up by £50, sorry about that - it's now £500 for the annual subscription fee.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Right, got that. And what's the next type?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Well, that's Silver- it's the same as Gold except you have to pay a small fee of £1.00 per lesson for any you do and you can only use the centre at certain times.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: I see. So when exactly?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: You can only use the facilities between I 0 am and 4.30 pm.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: So I couldn't use the pool at 8 in the morning or evening, then?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: That's right.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: OK. And the price for that? Is the joining fee the same as for Gold?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Actually, it's slightly less than the £250- it's £225, but the annual fee is only £300. Does that sound more like what you want?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Well, it's still rather more expensive than I thought. I'm a student here in England and I'm only here for six months.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Ah, then the Bronze scheme would probably suit you best.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: How is that different?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Well, some of the facilities have restricted use.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: And do I have to pay for classes?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Yes, it's £3 for each class you join.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: I see. And what are the hours then?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Between 10.30 and 3.30 weekdays only and you pay a £50 joining fee. The annual fee is £180- it works out at £15 a month, so that would be QB quite a lot cheaper.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Oh, that should be all right. I could come in my free periods. What do I have to do if I want to join?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Well, we book you in for an assessment with an instructor, who will show you how to use all the equipment. If you want to organise a trial session and look around the centre, you'll need to speak to David Kynchley.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Hmm. Could you spell that please?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Yes, David K- Y-N-C-H-L-E-Y. I'll give you his direct line number. It's oh- four- five-eight-nine-five-three-double one.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Thanks.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Thank you for calling Kingswell Sports Club.
